# Diana Barry

## Overview

- **Age:** 13  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P4](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0004)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Josephine Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) (relative)

## Appearance

Diana is a very pretty girl with rosy cheeks, black eyes, and glossy, jet-black hair inherited from her mother. Her dark tresses and striking features have notably captivated the hearts of the local schoolboys.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P22](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0022), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P10](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0010), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P12](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0012)_

## Personality

Diana Barry is characterized by her merry expression and has developed a notable taste in dressing, making her advice on fashion much sought after. She is also skilled at rowing a flat-bottomed dory.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P8](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P9](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0009)_

## History

Diana Barry was born in February and named by a schoolmaster who was boarding with her parents at the time. She formed an immediate and deep bond with [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) upon their first meeting at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope), where they solemnized their friendship with a garden oath. Although her mother temporarily forbade the two from playing together, Diana maintained a secret connection with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) by exchanging notes at school until [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) saved her younger sister, [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md), from a severe case of croup. Restored to full companionship, Diana later hosted a party where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) broke her ankle, and she supported her friend through school milestones, including gifting her a pair of slippers from [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) for a Christmas concert. Diana enthusiastically shared in Anne's academic journey, eventually being the one to deliver the joyous news that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) had tied for first place on the island's Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations. She later accompanied [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to a charity concert at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel), helping her dress for the event and riding home with her afterward.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P64](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0064), [v1 CHAPTER XII. ## Quotes

> "You hold your head with such an air. I suppose it’s your figure. I am just a dumpling. I’ve always been afraid of it, and now I know it is so. Well, I suppose I shall just have to resign myself to it."
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P13](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0013)

> "I don’t want to think of it, it makes me so miserable, and I do want to have a good time this evening. What are you going to recite, Anne? And are you nervous?"
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P24](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0024)

> "I’m awfully glad you’ve come to live at Green Gables. It will be jolly to have somebody to play with. There isn’t any other girl who lives near enough to play with, and I’ve no sisters big enough."
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P27](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0027)

> “Yes,” said Diana, tossing her head, “but I’m sure he doesn’t like Julia Bell so very much. I’ve heard him say he studied the multiplication table by her freckles.”
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P19](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0019)

> “Those Pye girls are cheats all round,” said Diana indignantly, as they climbed the fence of the main road. “Gertie Pye actually went and put her milk bottle in my place in the brook yesterday. Did you ever? I don’t speak to her now.”
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--diana-barry.md)

[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) is Diana's dearest, bosom friend. They met at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) and immediately bound themselves to each other with a solemn oath, quickly filling their days with imaginative games, romantic melodramas, and walk to school together. Though Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) temporarily separated them over a misunderstanding, their friendship was fully restored after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) helped save Diana's sick little sister.

- Friend of — dearest friend and bosom friend  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER XIII. ### [Jane](../character/jane.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana-barry--jane.md)
